item.title: SHAFT 0.70.0
item.description:
• Meetings: record a meeting from the Mac menu bar (Meeting → Record Online Meeting, ⇧⌘R). Online records your microphone and the call's sound; in person, the microphone. The recording goes only to your SHAFT server.
  • The server transcribes each meeting after it ends (Italian and English) and separates who spoke; Meeting → Show Meetings (⌥⌘M) shows the transcript.
  • Name a voice once in the Meetings window and later meetings recognise it.
  • Instances you grant can search and read meeting transcripts, marked as the participants' words, and suggest a speaker's name for you to confirm.
  • First time on the server: set up the transcription service (docs/meetings.md) and turn it on with shaft listen on.
  • Web chat edge cases fixed, and removed mechanisms' files are cleared.
